mnemonic: 辶 the road, and you're already past the turning. Nobody stopped, and the afternoon went by the same way: すぎる.
notes: Hung on the end of another word it means too much of it: 高過ぎる is too expensive. 過ごす すごす is you spending the time rather than it passing you.

sentence: 彼女は病気の犬を助けた。
mnemonic: 力 power stuck on the right-hand side. An extra shoulder put under the load. The dog was ill in a ditch and she carried it home: たすける.
notes: Stronger than English "help". It stretches all the way to rescuing and saving a life. 助かる たすかる is being on the receiving end of it.

sentence: 私は雨の日以外は自転車で学校に行く。
sentence_meaning: I go to school by bicycle except on rainy days.
mnemonic: 以 the marker that fixes a boundary, and 外 everything sat outside it. Every day on the bike, and rain filed on the far side of the line: いがい.
notes: Same 以 as 以上 いじょう. 以上 counts from a point upward; 以外 cuts one thing out and keeps the rest. Same reading as 意外 いがい, unexpected, which is a different word entirely.

sentence: 彼女が嘘をついたので、彼は怒った。
sentence_meaning: He was angry because she lied.
mnemonic: 奴 a servant sat on top of 心 the heart, and the heart underneath is doing all the work. She lied and he has gone quiet in a way that isn't quiet: おこる.
notes: One vowel from 起きる おきる, to get up, and identical in sound to 起こる おこる, to happen. Also covers telling someone off, not just being cross.
